name: OpenCLI
description_en: Make Any Website into CLI & Use your logged-in browser by AI agent.
readme_excerpt: OpenCLI > Convert any website into a CLI & run Browser Use on your logged-in Chrome. > Turn websites, browser sessions, Electron apps, and local tools into deterministic interfaces for humans and AI agents. > Or run Browser Use against any page — navigate, fill forms, click, extract, automate.
